groups.title: Statistical honesty

metrics.label: Rank IC (1d)
metrics.reads: Spearman correlation of score against forward return.

metrics.label: Rank IC (5d)
metrics.reads: Spearman correlation of score against forward return.

metrics.label: Rank IC (21d)
metrics.reads: Spearman correlation of score against forward return.

metrics.label: Rank IC (63d)
metrics.reads: Spearman correlation of score against forward return.

metrics.label: IC-IR (annualized)
metrics.reads: Consistency of prediction, not just its average.

metrics.label: Bootstrap IC confidence interval
metrics.reads: Nonparametric confidence interval on mean rank IC -- doesn't assume the period IC series is normal, unlike IC-IR's t-statistic.
metrics.source: block bootstrap of the backtest panel's per-period rank IC

metrics.label: IC decay curve
metrics.reads: Which horizon the edge lives at, against the cost of trading it.

metrics.label: Per-leg IC
metrics.reads: Which legs predict on their own rather than riding the blend.

metrics.label: Drop-one-leg delta IC
metrics.reads: Marginal contribution of each leg. The test that says whether assigned weights are defensible.
metrics.kill_threshold: Negative delta means the leg is hurting the composite

metrics.label: Leg correlation matrix
metrics.reads: Redundancy between legs. Two correlated legs are one leg counted twice.

metrics.label: Quantile spread and monotonicity
metrics.reads: Whether the whole ranking works or one tail is doing all of it.

metrics.label: Score autocorrelation
metrics.reads: Turnover the signal implies before a single trade is placed.

metrics.label: Rolling 12-period IC (regime monitor)
metrics.reads: Trailing-year mean rank IC of the published composite. The regime-turn alarm: R11-P13's regime diagnosis found the score anti-predicted through the 2018-2020 regime and flipped positive at the 2021-03 rotation -- a sustained negative reading here is the signature of that regime returning, visible within months instead of in a future backtest.

detail.regime_reference: R11-P13 regime diagnosis: break at 2021-03 (permutation p=0.019); champion mean IC -0.023 before, +0.038 after

metrics.label: FF5 + momentum loadings
metrics.display: market +0.91 size +0.64 value +0.46 profitability +0.12 investment -0.29 momentum +0.05
metrics.reads: The factor bets the portfolio is making, intended or not.
metrics.kill_threshold: Persistent negative momentum loading explains a capture spread

metrics.label: Effective N (1 / sum of squared weights)
metrics.reads: How many equally sized bets the book really is.

metrics.label: Top-10 weight
metrics.reads: Concentration the effective-N number can hide.

metrics.label: Rolling 60-day beta
metrics.reads: A point-estimate beta hides how unstable every beta-adjusted number on the dashboard is.
metrics.kill_threshold: A swing wider than 0.3 makes excess-return figures unstable

detail.series_note: most recent 60 of 2446 observations; swing and beta_range span the full history

metrics.label: Rolling beta swing (60d window)
metrics.reads: How unstable the 60-day beta estimate itself has been -- the number rolling_beta_60d's point estimate can't show on its own.
metrics.kill_threshold: Swing wider than 0.3 makes excess-return figures unstable

metrics.label: Net exposure drift
metrics.reads: Whether planned weights sum where they are supposed to.

metrics.label: Sector active weights
metrics.reads: Current production-sector weights minus SPY, retained prospectively by date.

metrics.label: Sector classification coverage
metrics.reads: Share of strategy weight the sector classifier could place. The active-weight figure above is unreliable below this coverage.

metrics.label: Sector allocation effect
metrics.reads: Sum across sectors of (active weight) times (that sector's real index return minus SPY's), using real sector SPDR ETFs. Positive means the sector tilt itself added return; says nothing about which stocks were picked within each sector.
metrics.source: sector-weight snapshot log and real sector SPDR total returns

metrics.label: Sector selection effect
metrics.reads: Whether stock-picking within each sector beat that sector's own index.
metrics.status_message: Needs the book's own realized return within each sector, joined to a historical sector classification per holding -- neither is logged today.

metrics.label: Breakeven gross alpha
metrics.reads: What the signal must earn gross before trading it is worth doing. Above the return the IC implies, the strategy is arithmetically dead.

metrics.label: Alpha versus cost crossover
metrics.display: No horizon clears its own cost
metrics.reads: The shortest holding period whose spread survives the round trip.

metrics.label: Position as a share of ADV
metrics.reads: The capacity ceiling. Above a few percent of daily volume the backtest fills stop being available in reality.

metrics.label: Implementation shortfall
metrics.reads: Decision price to fill price, in basis points, per trade.
metrics.status_message: Needs pipeline/data/validation/live_execution.json from an order or broker export; the research pipeline does not place trades.

metrics.label: Fill rate
metrics.reads: Share of intended quantity that executed.
metrics.status_message: Needs pipeline/data/validation/live_execution.json from an order or broker export; the research pipeline does not place trades.

metrics.label: Signals never positioned
metrics.reads: Intended positive-weight names absent from actual positions.
metrics.status_message: Needs pipeline/data/validation/live_execution.json from an order or broker export; the research pipeline does not place trades.

metrics.label: Order rejection rate
metrics.reads: Share of orders rejected by the broker or venue.
metrics.status_message: Needs pipeline/data/validation/live_execution.json from an order or broker export; the research pipeline does not place trades.

metrics.label: Realized vs. expected slippage
metrics.reads: Implementation shortfall against the cost model's pre-trade estimate, per trade.
metrics.status_message: Needs pipeline/data/validation/live_execution.json from an order or broker export; the research pipeline does not place trades.

metrics.label: Deflated Sharpe ratio
metrics.reads: Probability the Sharpe survives the number of configurations tried.
metrics.kill_threshold: Below 0.95 the result does not survive its own search

metrics.label: Probabilistic Sharpe ratio
metrics.reads: Probability the true Sharpe is above zero given this sample.
metrics.kill_threshold: Below 0.95 the sample cannot support the claim

metrics.label: Minimum track record length
metrics.reads: How long until the Sharpe claim is defensible.

metrics.label: Probability of backtest overfitting
metrics.reads: Chance the configuration that won the search beats the median out of sample. Above a half, the selection process is producing noise.
metrics.status_message: 3 holdout folds. CSCV wants at least 8 blocks, so read this as directional until the optimizer writes more folds.

detail.reason: 3 holdout folds. CSCV wants at least 8 blocks, so read this as directional until the optimizer writes more folds.

metrics.label: Bootstrap return/Sharpe confidence interval
metrics.reads: Block-bootstrap uncertainty band on annualized return and Sharpe -- a defensible interval without waiting for 253 daily returns.
metrics.source: block bootstrap of backtest daily returns

metrics.label: White's Reality Check / SPA test
metrics.reads: Whether the best-searched configuration beats the field by more than an exhaustive search of this many configurations would produce from noise alone.
metrics.kill_threshold: p-value above 0.05 -- the edge is not distinguishable from search noise
metrics.status_message: Not enough complete holdout periods across configurations for the SPA bootstrap.

detail.reason: Not enough complete holdout periods across configurations for the SPA bootstrap.

metrics.label: Rolling 60-day Sharpe
metrics.reads: Whether one lucky stretch is carrying the headline Sharpe, or the edge holds across the full window.

metrics.label: VaR backtest (95%)
metrics.reads: Kupiec tests whether the breach rate matches the stated coverage; Christoffersen tests whether breaches cluster instead of scattering.
metrics.kill_threshold: Kupiec or Christoffersen rejects calibration at 95%
metrics.source: rolling historical VaR against backtest daily returns

metrics.label: VaR backtest (99%)
metrics.reads: Kupiec tests whether the breach rate matches the stated coverage; Christoffersen tests whether breaches cluster instead of scattering.
metrics.kill_threshold: Kupiec or Christoffersen rejects calibration at 95%
metrics.source: rolling historical VaR against backtest daily returns

metrics.label: Treynor ratio
metrics.reads: Annualized excess return per unit of systematic risk. Comparable across portfolios with different total volatility in a way Sharpe is not.
metrics.kill_threshold: Negative Treynor means losing money on a beta-adjusted basis

metrics.label: Jensen's alpha (single-factor CAPM)
metrics.reads: The classic Jensen (1968) single-factor alpha: return beta does not explain. More conservative than the FF5+momentum alpha in construction diagnostics, which lets more factors explain the return away first.
metrics.kill_threshold: Alpha at or below zero -- beta alone explains the return

metrics.label: After-tax return
metrics.reads: Realized return after short-term capital gains, alongside the pre-tax figure.
metrics.status_message: Needs trade-level realized gain/loss and holding-period logging (the Priority 1 cost/capacity work); short-term capital-gains treatment cannot be applied without it.

metrics.label: 2022 rate-shock stress window
metrics.reads: How this book's own realized exposures performed through the 2022 rate-shock period.

metrics.label: 2020 COVID-crash stress window
metrics.reads: Hypothetical drawdown under a 2020-style crash, replaying factor and sector exposures.
metrics.status_message: The backtest window starts in mid-2021; no priced day of this strategy's own exposures exists for the 2020 crash, and fabricating one via factor replay is not evidence.

metrics.label: Beta to long Treasuries (rate sensitivity)
metrics.reads: Beta of the book's daily returns to TLT (long Treasuries). Positive means the book tends to fall when long rates rise, the way a bond would; negative means it tends to benefit from rising rates.
metrics.source: backtest equity curve versus TLT total return

metrics.label: 2008 Global Financial Crisis
metrics.reads: S&P 500 all-time high (2007-10-09) to the post-crisis trough (2009-03-09). Projected through this book's own measured factor loadings and market beta, not replayed from its own returns -- the strategy did not exist yet.

detail.label: 2008 Global Financial Crisis
detail.description: S&P 500 all-time high (2007-10-09) to the post-crisis trough (2009-03-09).

metrics.source: Fama-French factor windows and SPY/TLT total-return history, projected through measured exposures

metrics.label: March 2020 COVID crash
metrics.reads: S&P 500 pre-pandemic high (2020-02-19) to the fastest bear-market trough on record (2020-03-23). Projected through this book's own measured factor loadings and market beta, not replayed from its own returns -- the strategy did not exist yet.

detail.label: March 2020 COVID crash
detail.description: S&P 500 pre-pandemic high (2020-02-19) to the fastest bear-market trough on record (2020-03-23).

metrics.source: Fama-French factor windows and SPY/TLT total-return history, projected through measured exposures

metrics.label: 2022 rate-hike drawdown
metrics.reads: S&P 500 high (2022-01-03) to the 2022 bear-market low (2022-10-12), the Fed's steepest hiking cycle in four decades. Projected through this book's own measured factor loadings and market beta, not replayed from its own returns -- the strategy did not exist yet.

detail.label: 2022 rate-hike drawdown
detail.description: S&P 500 high (2022-01-03) to the 2022 bear-market low (2022-10-12), the Fed's steepest hiking cycle in four decades.

metrics.source: Fama-French factor windows and SPY/TLT total-return history, projected through measured exposures

metrics.label: Hypothetical: SPY -30%
metrics.reads: A flat, hypothetical SPY move projected through the book's measured market beta. A linear extrapolation, not a measurement.
metrics.source: linear projection through the book's measured market beta

metrics.label: Hypothetical: rates +200bp
metrics.reads: A hypothetical 200bp rate move, converted to a TLT price move via an assumed 17-year effective duration, projected through the book's measured beta to TLT. A modeling assumption stacked on a linear extrapolation, not a measurement.
metrics.source: linear projection through the book's measured TLT beta and an assumed duration

metrics.label: Omega ratio
metrics.reads: Probability-weighted gains over losses against the cash rate.
metrics.status_message: 11 matched live return periods of 120. Any reading before roughly six months is decorative.
metrics.source: immutable production shadow returns; backtest reference shown

metrics.label: Ulcer index
metrics.reads: How deep and how long the underwater periods run.
metrics.status_message: 11 matched live return periods of 120. Any reading before roughly six months is decorative.
metrics.source: immutable production shadow returns; backtest reference shown

metrics.label: Martin ratio
metrics.reads: Excess return per unit of drawdown pain.
metrics.status_message: 11 matched live return periods of 120. Any reading before roughly six months is decorative.
metrics.source: immutable production shadow returns; backtest reference shown

metrics.label: CVaR-95
metrics.reads: Average loss on the worst 5% of days.
metrics.status_message: 11 matched live return periods of 120. Any reading before roughly six months is decorative.
metrics.source: immutable production shadow returns; backtest reference shown

metrics.label: Skew
metrics.reads: Which side of the distribution is the fat one.
metrics.status_message: 11 matched live return periods of 120. Any reading before roughly six months is decorative.
metrics.source: immutable production shadow returns; backtest reference shown

metrics.label: Excess kurtosis
metrics.reads: How much fatter the tails are than normal.
metrics.status_message: 11 matched live return periods of 120. Any reading before roughly six months is decorative.
metrics.source: immutable production shadow returns; backtest reference shown

metrics.label: Tail ratio
metrics.reads: Best tail against worst tail.
metrics.status_message: 11 matched live return periods of 120. Any reading before roughly six months is decorative.
metrics.source: immutable production shadow returns; backtest reference shown

metrics.label: Gain to pain
metrics.reads: Net gain per unit of loss taken.
metrics.status_message: 11 matched live return periods of 120. Any reading before roughly six months is decorative.
metrics.source: immutable production shadow returns; backtest reference shown

metrics.label: Rolling 60-day live IC versus backtest
metrics.reads: The decay alarm. Live IC below the backtest confidence interval means the edge is gone or was never there.
metrics.kill_threshold: Live IC below the backtest 95% interval
metrics.status_message: accumulating, 0 of 24 periods

metrics.label: Feature distribution PSI
metrics.reads: Detects when the live feature population leaves its earlier PIT window.
metrics.status_message: Needs 60 point-in-time days for separated baseline and current windows; 17 recorded.

detail.reason: Needs 60 point-in-time days for separated baseline and current windows; 17 recorded.

metrics.label: Live versus backtest daily return divergence
metrics.reads: Mean prospective production return versus the historical backtest mean.
metrics.kill_threshold: Absolute mean divergence above the 95% backtest sampling interval
metrics.status_message: Directional only until 20 matched live periods.

detail.reason: Directional only until 20 matched live periods.

metrics.label: Data quality counters
metrics.reads: Missing/stale price observations, duplicate rows, quality flags, and universe churn.
metrics.kill_threshold: Any missing, unstamped, stale, or duplicate current price row

corporate_action_monitoring.reason: No prospective corporate-action event log exists; no miss count is inferred.

metrics.label: Position reconciliation
metrics.reads: Intended against actual weights at the close.
metrics.status_message: Needs intended and actual close weights in pipeline/data/validation/live_execution.json.

detail.reason: Needs intended and actual close weights in pipeline/data/validation/live_execution.json.
